cues.zh: 好，你们见过玩魔方的大神吧？那些解法就像直接刻在他们脑干里一样
cues.en: Okay, you've seen Rubik's cube solvers right? These guys that like have it stored somewhere in their brain stem

cues.zh: ——他们看一眼就能立刻明白该怎么转，怎样才能复原
cues.en: - and they can look at it and just instantly understand what they need to do right, to solve the thing

cues.zh: 直升机飞行员其实也是这样，因为你想想看
cues.en: Well that's exactly what helicopter pilots are doing because if you think about it

cues.zh: ——魔方上每变动一下，整块东西上的很多面都会跟着改变
cues.en: - every time you change something, on a Rubik's cube, multiple inputs are changing all over the thing

cues.zh: 这是一个联动系统，直升机也是这个原理
cues.en: It's a whole system, that's the way helicopters work

cues.zh: 你必须瞬间做出最高效、最有效的解法，直接一步到位
cues.en: You have to come up with the most efficient and effective solution instantly to arrive at that perfect solution right of the bat

cues.zh: 这必须得练成肌肉记忆才行
cues.en: That's something you have to get in muscle memory somehow

cues.zh: 直升机有三个主要操纵机构，第一个我们称之为：总距杆
cues.en: Okay there are three main controls for a helicopter The first one is what we call: collective

cues.zh: 总距杆决定了施加在旋翼系统上的动力
cues.en: Collective is your power that you are applying to the rotor system

cues.zh: 基本上，斜盘会整体移动，转动那些旋翼桨叶，让它们在空气中吃进更多或更少的气流
cues.en: Basically the swash-plate moves together and it rotates those rotor blades so that they're taking more or less of a bite out of the air

cues.zh: 想想看，当你这么做的时候，机身承受的反作用扭矩就会变大或变小，对吧
cues.en: Now if you think about that, when you do that it applies more torque or less torque to the body of the helicopter right

cues.zh: 所以你必须用脚舵来抵消它
cues.en: So you have to counter-act that with the pedals

cues.zh: 当她前后踩动脚舵时，自然会给整个机身带来更多或更少的反向扭矩
cues.en: When she moves the pedals back and forth, that, of course, gives you more or less counter-torque on the body of the whole aircraft

cues.zh: 另一件需要考虑的事是，尾桨在吹风，所以它会把整架直升机往侧面推，对吧
cues.en: Another thing that you need to think about is that tail-rotor is blowing air, so it's pushing the whole helicopter to the side, right

cues.zh: ——那么抵消它的方法是什么呢？周期变距杆（Cyclic）
cues.en: - so the way you counteract that is what? Cyclic

cues.zh: 周期变距杆和总距杆类似，都是通过斜盘来改变桨叶角度，只不过它是非同步改变的
cues.en: Cyclic is similar to collective in that it moves the rotors in the swash-plate, only it does it independently

cues.zh: 你可以看到它在调整斜盘，让各个桨叶彼此独立地运动
cues.en: You can see that it is changing the swash-plate so that the rotors are moving independently of each other

cues.zh: 她必须做的，就是把这三种输入结合起来，让它们协同工作

cues.zh: 我们玩得特别开心
cues.en: We had a blast

cues.zh: 如果你想找个地方度假，欢迎考虑佛罗里达州的圣彼得堡—克利尔沃特地区
cues.en: If you are looking for a place to take a vacation please consider the St.Pete Clearwater Florida area

cues.zh: 那儿的海滩特别适合放松
cues.en: It's a great place just to go chill on the beach

cues.zh: 有机会的话，去圣彼得堡—克利尔沃特看看
cues.en: If you get a chance, visit St. Pete Clearwater

cues.zh: 欢迎考虑去那里，视频简介里我会放个链接
cues.en: Please consider it, I'll leave a link in the video description

cues.zh: 啊，感谢你们赞助这期视频，真的很感谢
cues.en: Ah, thank you for sponsoring this, I appreciate that

cues.zh: 总之，我是 Destin，你正在收看《每天变聪明一点》，祝你今天愉快
cues.en: Anyway, I'm Destin, you're getting Smarter Every Day, have a good one

cues.zh: （Destin）所以你觉得悬停是那样的吗？……嗯，你已经搞砸了，这我现在就看得出来
cues.en: (Destin) So you don't think hovering is like that?...well you're already messing it up I can tell you that right now

cues.zh: （Destin）你要当固定翼飞行教练吗？（Brandon）不，我完全不想教人开固定翼飞机
cues.en: (Destin) Are you going to be a fixed wing instructor? (Brandon) No, I have no desire to be a fixed wing instructor

cues.zh: （Destin）为什么？（Brandon）我不喜欢开飞机
cues.en: (Destin) Why is that? (Brandon) I don't like flying airplanes

cues.zh: ——想想看……你能在飞机里这样做吗？
cues.en: - think about it...can you do this right here in an airplane?

cues.zh: (Destin) 不
cues.en: (Destin) No

cues.zh: (Brandon) 好吧
cues.en: (Brandon) Alright then

cues.zh: 我们现在和海豚温特以及她的训练员在克利尔沃特海洋水族馆
cues.en: We're here with Winter, the dolphin, at Clearwater Marine Aquarium and her trainers

cues.zh: - 你们叫什么名字？卡米……还有朱莉
cues.en: - and your names are? Cammy...and Julie

cues.zh: 好，这是温特的假尾鳍
cues.en: Alright and this is Winter's prosthetic tail

cues.zh: 我就是在这里练习直升机飞行动作的
cues.en: So this is were I practiced some helicopter maneuvers

cues.zh: 这是达利博物馆
cues.en: And this is the Dali museum

cues.zh: (Destin) 不过你开直升机很快就能做到
cues.en: (Destin) But you can do that with a helicopter quickly

cues.zh: (Destin 和 Michelle 笑)
cues.en: (Destin and Michelle laugh)
